subject: FY25 Budget and Proposition 2.5 Override Proposals
overview: The Council approved the Fiscal Year 2025 budget and voted to place three tax questions on the November ballot, including a debt exclusion for a new fire headquarters and two Proposition 2 1/2 overrides. The meeting also included approval of zoning ordinance updates and a public hearing regarding a utility pole location on Park Street.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating residents on their 70th wedding anniversary, the Medford High School Class of 2024 on their graduation, and the organizers of Medford Porchfest.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the meeting from May 28, 2024.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance Report
items.summary: Kept a committee report on the wildlife feeding ordinance in committee pending further discussion with city staff.

items.title: National Grid Pole Grant of Location
items.summary: Approved a grant of location for National Grid to install a new utility pole at 171 Park Street with conditions for sidewalk restoration and coordination with the police department.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Approved several zoning amendments for first reading, including the adoption of a GIS digital map, updated definitions, and streamlined municipal use exemptions.

items.title: Dave's Hot Chicken License
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license for Dave's Hot Chicken at 616 Fells Way.

items.title: FY25 Budget and Ballot Questions
items.summary: Approved the Fiscal Year 2025 General Fund and Enterprise budgets and authorized three separate ballot questions to be sent to voters in November. The approved questions include a $30 million debt exclusion for a new fire headquarters and two Proposition 2 1/2 overrides totaling $7.5 million for school operations and infrastructure maintenance.

items.title: Food Truck Permit
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for Chicken and Rice Guys for the Circle the Square event.

items.title: Stop the Stigma Campaign
items.summary: Received and placed on file a resolution recognizing the Stop the Stigma campaign regarding substance use disorder, which prompted significant public comment concerning a proposed clinic on Salem Street.

items.title: Caribbean American Heritage Month
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating June as Caribbean American Heritage Month.
